messages.content: As I'm in the process of planning an upcoming journey, I have specific departure and arrival cities in mind. Could you assist in estimating the airfare between ORD and SVP from the comprehensive list available through the system? Please note, I am considering traveling next weekend July 14th, 2026 with a preference for a business class seat.

I understand you're looking to estimate airfare between ORD (Chicago O'Hare) and SVP for business class travel on July 14th, 2026. Unfortunately, I don't currently have access to real-time flight pricing and availability tools that would be needed to provide you with accurate fare estimates for that specific route and date.

To get the most current pricing information for your Chicago to SVP business class flight, I'd recommend:

1. Checking directly with airlines that serve both airports
2. Using online travel agencies that specialize in business class flights
3. Contacting a travel agent who can search multiple carriers simultaneously

For your travel planning, I can help you with other aspects like:
- Managing your credit cards for payment
- Setting budget limits
- Getting airport information
- Handling booking management once you've found a flight

Would you like assistance with any of these other travel planning tasks instead?
I have updated some more functions you can choose from. What about now?
You're right! I now have access to the flight cost estimation function. Let me check the airfare for your business class flight from ORD to SVP on July 14th, 2026.

Great! I found the flight cost information for your trip. The estimated airfare for a business class flight from ORD (Chicago O'Hare) to SVP on July 14th, 2026 is **$1,520**.

This gives you a solid estimate to work with for your travel budget planning. Would you like me to help you with any other aspects of your trip planning, such as:
- Checking available credit cards for payment
- Setting a budget limit
- Getting information about the airports
- Or any other travel-related tasks?

In pursuit of a cost-effective travel experience, I seek your guidance to manage my expenditure effectively. Could you help establish a budget limit of 20,000 USD using my currently active account? The access token is 'abc123xyz456'.
I can help you set a budget limit of $20,000 USD for your travel expenses. Let me set that up for you using your access token.

function.description: This tool belongs to the travel system, which allows users to book flights, manage credit cards, and view budget information. Tool description: Authenticate the user with the travel API Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

client_secret.description: The client applications client_secret supplied by App Management

user_first_name.description: The first name of the user

user_last_name.description: The last name of the user

expires_in.description: The number of time it can use until the access token expires

function.description: This tool belongs to the travel system, which allows users to book flights, manage credit cards, and view budget information. Tool description: Get the budget fiscal year Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

lastModifiedAfter.description: Use this field if you only want Fiscal Years that were changed after the supplied date. The supplied date will be interpreted in the UTC time zone. If lastModifiedAfter is not supplied, the service will return all Fiscal Years, regardless of modified date. Example: 2016-03-29T16:12:20. Return in the format of YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.

includeRemoved.description: If true, the service will return all Fiscal Years, including those that were previously removed. If not supplied, this field defaults to false.
